steps: Sign in to Netflix on the web (not the TV app).
Open the cancel page — it is one confirmation click.
You keep access until the end of the current billing period.
info.notes: If billed through Apple or a partner (e.g. a telecom bundle), cancel there instead.

steps: Sign in at spotify.com — Premium cannot be cancelled from the mobile app.
Under Your plan, choose Change plan.
Scroll to Cancel Spotify and confirm. You drop to the free tier at period end.
Sign in on the web and open Account.
Select your subscription, then Cancel subscription.
Complete the confirmation screens (they will offer alternatives first).
info.notes: Billed via Apple/Google/Amazon? Cancel in that store's subscription settings.

steps: Sign in and open Manage Your Prime Membership.
Choose End membership — Amazon shows several retention screens; keep clicking through to the final confirmation.
If you have not used Prime benefits since the last charge, ask for a refund of that charge via chat.
Sign in and open your paid memberships page.
Select Manage membership, then Deactivate.
Choose Cancel (not Pause) and confirm.
Open your Apple subscriptions (Settings → your name → Subscriptions on iPhone, or the link above).
Select Apple TV+ and tap Cancel Subscription.
Access continues until the end of the billing period.
Open your Apple subscriptions (Settings → your name → Subscriptions on iPhone, or the link above).
Select Apple Music and tap Cancel Subscription.
On iPhone: Settings → your name → iCloud → Manage Account Storage → Change Storage Plan.
Choose Downgrade Options, sign in, and pick the free 5 GB tier.
Make sure your data fits the new tier first — over-quota data stops syncing.
Sign in at crave.ca and open My Account.
Under your subscription, choose Cancel Subscription and confirm.
Subscribed through a TV provider or app store? Cancel there instead.
Sign in on the web and open your account page.
Select Cancel subscription and confirm through the retention offer.
Prime Video is part of Amazon Prime — cancelling Prime cancels it.
For standalone channel add-ons: Amazon account → Memberships & Subscriptions → cancel the channel.
Sign in on the desktop website — membership cannot be cancelled in the app.
Open Account Details → Cancel membership.
Click through the retention offers (pause, discounted months) to the final confirmation.
Unused credits are forfeited at cancellation — spend them first.
SiriusXM has no self-serve cancellation — you must contact them by chat or phone.
Open their contact page and start a chat; say clearly you want to cancel, not pause.
Expect strong retention offers. If you want out, repeat that you want to cancel effective immediately.
Ask for an email confirmation of the cancellation and keep it.
Open Google One and go to Settings (or Membership).
Choose Cancel membership and confirm.
Your storage drops to 15 GB at period end — make sure your data fits.
Sign in and open Settings → Plan.
Select Cancel plan at the bottom and click through the retention screens.
You keep paid features until the end of the billing period.
Sign in to your Microsoft account services page.
Find Microsoft 365, choose Manage → Cancel subscription.
If you are within 30 days of a renewal charge you can usually get it refunded.
Sign in at account.adobe.com and open Plans.
Choose Manage plan → Cancel plan.
IMPORTANT: the common 'Annual, billed monthly' plan carries an early-termination fee of ~50% of the remaining months after the first 14 days.
Within 14 days of purchase or renewal you can cancel for a full refund — check that date before deciding.
If the fee applies, chat support will sometimes waive it or switch you to a cheaper plan — ask.
Sign in and open Settings → Billing & plans.
Choose Cancel subscription on your plan and confirm.
Open Settings & members → Billing (workspace owner only).
Choose Change plan → downgrade to Free.
Content stays; you lose paid features like unlimited version history.
Sign in to your account on the web and open your profile → Billing.
Cancel the subscription; your account becomes frozen (read-only) rather than deleted.
Export your vaults first if you plan to move to another manager.
Sign in to your Nord Account → Billing → Subscriptions.
Turn OFF auto-renewal — that is the actual cancellation for prepaid terms.
Charged a renewal you did not want? Their support chat refunds within 30 days of the charge.
Sign in to your ExpressVPN account dashboard.
Under Subscription, turn off automatic renewal and confirm through both prompts.
30-day money-back window applies from purchase or renewal via live chat.
Sign in at my.norton.com and open My Subscriptions.
Select Cancel Subscription Renewal (may be labelled Manage Renewal) and confirm.
Norton's annual-renewal refund window is 60 days from the renewal charge — request it via chat if you were just billed.
Sign in at home.mcafee.com and open My Account → Auto-Renewal Settings.
Turn auto-renewal off and confirm.
Refunds for unwanted renewals are available within 60 days via their support chat.
Sign in, click your profile → Settings → Subscription.
Choose Manage and then Cancel plan (billing is handled by Stripe).
Access continues until the end of the paid period.
Sign in at claude.ai and open Settings → Billing.
Choose Cancel subscription and confirm.
Access continues until the end of the paid period.
Open Settings → Billing and plans.
Under your plan, choose Downgrade to Free.
Private repos and data remain; paid features stop at period end.
Sign in to the web portal and open Account Management → Billing.
On the Current Plans tab choose Cancel Plan and confirm.
Open Premium subscription settings (Me → Premium features → Manage, or the link above).
Choose Cancel subscription and click through the retention offers.
Cancel at least one day before the renewal date — LinkedIn does not refund renewals.
Open your account dashboard and select the site.
Settings → Billing → Subscriptions → your plan → Cancel subscription.
Your site content stays for a while after expiry, but export anything important first.
From your store admin open Settings → Plan.
Choose Deactivate store (or Pause if you might return — pause still bills a reduced fee).
Cancel any app subscriptions first; they bill separately.
Sign in and open the Subscription page.
Choose Cancel Subscription at the bottom and confirm through the offers.
Cancellation depends on where you subscribed: duolingo.com, Apple, or Google.
On the web: Settings → Super Duolingo → Cancel.
Via an app store: cancel in that store's subscription settings instead.
Open My Purchases while signed in.
Find the subscription and choose Cancel subscription.
Coursera Plus refunds within 14 days of payment if unused.
Open your subscription overview page.
Choose Cancel — in Canada you can usually complete it online; if not, it hands you to chat.
In chat, decline the discounted retention offers unless one genuinely works for you, and ask for written confirmation.
The Globe requires contacting customer care to cancel — there is no self-serve button.
Use the contact options on their customer-help page (phone or message form).
State clearly that you want to cancel, note the date, and ask for an email confirmation.
Sign in to your Economist account portal.
Open Manage subscription → Cancel; some regions route you to chat to finish.
Ask for confirmation in writing and note any refund for the unused period.
GoodLife memberships are contracts — check your agreement for the notice period (typically 30 days).
Submit the cancellation request through Member Services online or at your home club in person.
Ontario and several provinces give you a 10-day cooling-off right after signing — if you just joined, invoke it.
Keep the written confirmation; one more billing cycle after notice is normal, more is not.
Most Planet Fitness locations require cancelling in person at your home club or by letter — the app cannot do it.
Visit your home club and complete a cancellation form, or send a letter (registered mail) to the club.
Mind the annual fee date — cancel before it or you will be charged it one last time.
Keep a copy of the form or letter as evidence.
Cancellation terms are set by your home club's agreement — check the notice period (usually 30 days).
Email or visit your home club with a written cancellation request naming your membership number.
Ask for written confirmation of the end date and the last billing.
Sign in at onepeloton.ca and open My Membership.
Choose Cancel (App membership) — All-Access tied to hardware can be paused or cancelled the same way.
Subscribed via Apple or Google? Cancel in that store instead.
Manage the subscription where you bought it: calm.com, Apple, or Google.
On the web: account settings → Manage Subscription → turn off renewal.
The trial converts silently — cancel at least 24h before it ends if you are in one.
Sign in at headspace.com and open Manage subscription.
Choose Cancel subscription — if you subscribed via Apple/Google, do it in that store instead.
Cancelling or changing a Rogers plan requires talking to them — call or use live chat and say 'cancel my service' to reach retentions.
If you are on a term contract, ask for the exact early-cancellation cost first.
For price increases: retentions can usually match competitor offers — name a real competing plan and ask directly.
Get the confirmation number and the final billing date before hanging up. A final partial bill is normal (30-day notice was abolished; cancellation is effective the date you set).
Call Bell or use chat and ask for the loyalty/cancellation department.
On contract? Ask for the exact cancellation fee and your contract end date first.
For price increases, a competitor quote in hand is your leverage — ask them to match it.
Record the agent's name, the confirmation number, and the service end date.
Call TELUS or use their chat; say 'cancel service' to route to the loyalty team.
Ask for any device-balance or contract-exit amounts up front.
Loyalty can often apply retention pricing if you mention a specific competitor plan.
Confirm the end date and ask for an email or My TELUS record of the change.
Call Fido or use live chat and ask to cancel — you will be routed to retentions.
Ask about any remaining device financing balance; it becomes due on cancellation.
Keep the confirmation number and final billing date.
Sign in to Account Management (web or console) → Subscriptions.
Select PlayStation Plus → Turn Off Auto-Renew.
You keep benefits until the paid period ends; games from Plus stop working after.
Open your Microsoft services page and find Game Pass.
Choose Manage → Cancel subscription (or turn off recurring billing).
Within the refund window Microsoft often refunds the latest charge — the cancel flow shows if you qualify.
Sign in to your Nintendo Account → Shop Menu → Your Subscriptions.
Turn off automatic renewal for Nintendo Switch Online.
Family plan? Only the purchasing account can turn it off.
Cancel where you subscribed: EA account portal, PlayStation, Xbox, or Steam.
On EA's site: Subscriptions → Cancel membership.
Console subscriptions must be cancelled on that console's store.
Open User Settings → Subscriptions (desktop or web app).
Under Nitro choose Cancel and confirm — benefits run to period end.
Open your subscriptions page on the web (not the mobile app if subscribed via web).
Find the channel subscription and choose Don't Renew Subscription.
Open Settings → Memberships (web browser — the iOS app can't cancel).
Choose Edit next to the membership, then Cancel membership.
Open your Substack settings → Subscriptions.
Select the publication → Cancel subscription; you keep access until period end.
Manage where you subscribed: strava.com, Apple, or Google.
On the web: Settings → My Account → Subscription Management → cancel renewal.
Sign in on the web and open Account → Subscription.
Turn off auto-renew. MasterClass is annual — set a reminder before the renewal date next time.
